notes.title: Feature Update:
notes.content:
Scroll through abilities: Seed, Feed (nutrients), Special abilities, Weapons.
Weapons can be upgraded through the bribe system.

notes.title: Feature Update:
notes.content: Beware the giant fire spitting flowers! You can mix up a Fire Shield potion for protection. You can also shrink these flowers with a Mutator Whip.

notes.title: Feature Update:
notes.content: Find the recipe to mix View Changer potion. It is possible to see changes in the world around you that reveal ways to reach new realms.

notes.title: Feature Update:
notes.content:
Search the shop and realms to discover sticky notes. These reveal potion recipes you'll need.
Light up the surface of a sticky note to discover the ingredients to mix the potion and where it needs to be sent. Open your Journal to match the potion with the delivery location.
